0022600114.text: The Orlando Magic (0-2, 13th in the East) visit the New York Knicks (0-2, 11th in the East) in a matchup of two winless teams. Orlando, 4th in the Southeast and 1.5 games back, is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain; 24.5 points and 33.8 minutes per game this season), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), while New York is without Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain) and sits 4th in the Atlantic, 2.5 games back. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the most recent meeting on December 13, 2025 in Orlando, a 132-120 Magic loss.
